# sanity_project (Resource)

Manages a Sanity.io project. Projects are the top-level container for datasets, tokens, CORS origins, and webhooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a new Sanity project
resource "sanity_project" "example" {
  project_name    = "Production Application"
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
}

# Reference the created project ID in other resources:
# output "project_id" {
#   value = sanity_project.example.id
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_name` (String) The human-readable name of the Sanity project.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID to which this project belongs (e.g. `o-xyz12345`). Highly recommended so the project appears in your team's organization dashboard.
- `studio_host` (String) The custom studio subdomain hosted on sanity.studio (e.g. `my-app` maps to `my-app.sanity.studio`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the project was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Sanity project (e.g. `xyz12345`).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the project was last updated.
